primary_metric: case mean across two sampler seeds of normalized motor RMSE over first10 x 6 vs own BF16 reference
selection_rule: Minimize mean primary metric on selection cases independently for phase1, scalar phase2 and VQ phase2; ties use declared config order; freeze winners before test queries.
phase2_test_rule: Evaluate both quantizers at Identity and at the union of their selection-winning transforms, ensuring paired same-transform held-out comparisons.
numerical_control: Evaluate each phase1 transformed BF16-weight/BF16-input configuration on selection cases. Report drift from original BF16; compare A4 output with both original and same-transform BF16 control.
activation_recipe: dynamic per-row absmax signed symmetric Q4, qmax=7, round and clamp, decoded BF16
scalar_recipe: per-output-row input-channel groups of 128, symmetric signed W4, BF16 scales rounded before encoding and packed nibbles; decoded BF16 reference arithmetic
vq_metric: candidate-specific empirical per-channel second moment of actual decoded Q4 transformed inputs; diagonal local Linear-output proxy, not final-action sensitivity
weight_scope: all selected Linear in video_expert, action_expert and proprio_encoder, identical to previous pilot
unquantized: KV cache, bias, normalization, nonlinearities, text encoder, VAE and other non-target modules remain original precision
sampler: idm, 10 video + 10 action denoising steps, action chunk [32,7], no action ensembler
claim_scope: fixed-observation numerical mechanism validation; zero evaluation episodes and no native VQ latency claim
